tasks.short: Contract for cleaning and security services

steps.what: Prepare contracts for cleaning, maintenance, and security services
Review the property services contract before sending
Send the accepted contract for provision of those services
Administer the accepted cleaning and security services

tasks.design: The manager prepares and administers contracts for provision of property services, such as cleaning, maintenance, and security services. The manager writes and reviews the contract. {EMAIL} sends only the accepted version. Administering the service on site stays at full effort.
tasks.previous_blocker: The manager drafted the contract, sent it, and then checked the work on site.
tasks.enabler_now: An accepted contract can be sent as written.
tasks.still_hard: Writing the terms and checking the service on site stay with the manager.
tasks.human_edge: The manager stops a contract that names the wrong property or the wrong price.
tasks.altitude: The contract is sent only after the manager accepts that version. Administering the service stays on site.

reach.task: Perform the cleaning, maintenance, or security service
reach.learn: Which duties the contractor says are outside the contract.

evidence.claim: An accepted services contract can be sent as written. Preparing it and administering the service stay manual.

assumptions: The work starts with a service the property needs and ends when the accepted contract is sent and the manager has checked the service, or stops.
The draft has property identifier, service type, and price, written by the manager. A blank price is left blank and is not sent.
The send uses the contract accepted in the review. A later change of price voids that acceptance.
unknowns: Which services must be re-tendered rather than renewed.
research_questions: How often did the review change the price before sending?

already_counted.description: Administering the property services is already in the manager's step.

incremental.description: Correct a service price on the contract before it is accepted.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: each contract is still written from scratch, so sending is a small part. High: the contract is reviewed and sent, and administering the service remains. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Open stored terms of occupancy and local area notes
Meet prospective tenants and show the properties
Explain terms of occupancy and provide information about local areas

tasks.design: The manager meets prospective tenants to show properties, explains terms of occupancy, and provides information about local areas. {DOCS} opens the stored terms. A missing term stays blank. Showing the property and explaining the terms stay at full effort.
tasks.previous_blocker: The manager carried a printed sheet and walked the property with the tenant.
tasks.enabler_now: A property identifier can open terms already written.
tasks.still_hard: Showing the rooms and talking with the tenant stay in person.
tasks.human_edge: The manager does not state a term that is blank on the sheet.
tasks.altitude: The showing stays the visit. Only finding the terms sheet is shorter.

reach.learn: Which terms the tenant did not understand.

evidence.claim: A stored property identifier can open occupancy terms. Showing the property stays manual.

assumptions: The work starts when a prospective tenant arrives and ends when the showing is over or the manager stops.
A terms row has property identifier and the occupancy terms, entered by the manager. A missing term is left blank.
Opening the sheet does not shorten the showing. No eligibility decision is made in this task.
unknowns: Which local points the organisation wants every showing to cover.
research_questions: How often was the terms sheet blank, so the manager explained from the lease?

already_counted.description: Showing properties to prospective tenants is already in the manager's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the showing adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the terms are often blank, so the showing is unchanged. High: the terms open, and showing the property still takes the visit. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Market vacant space to prospective tenants
Review the advertising before it is sent
Send the accepted advertising through leasing agents
Cover other methods the leasing agents do not

tasks.design: The manager markets vacant space to prospective tenants through leasing agents, advertising, or other methods. The manager writes and reviews the advertising. {EMAIL} sends only the accepted text through the agents. Other methods stay at full effort.
tasks.previous_blocker: The manager wrote the advert, sent it, and also told people directly.
tasks.enabler_now: An accepted advert can be sent as written.
tasks.still_hard: Deciding how to describe the space, and the methods the agents do not cover, stay with the manager.
tasks.human_edge: The manager will not send a rent or a size that is blank.
tasks.altitude: Advertising is sent only after the manager accepts that text. Other methods stay in their hands.

reach.task: Show the vacant space to a prospective tenant
reach.learn: Which units the agent is not instructed to market.

evidence.claim: An accepted advertising text can be sent to a leasing agent. Writing it and the other methods stay manual.

assumptions: The work starts with a vacant unit and ends when the accepted advertising is sent or the manager stops.
The draft has unit identifier, rent, and a description, written by the manager. A blank rent is left blank and is not sent.
The send uses the advertising accepted in the review. A later change of rent voids that acceptance.
unknowns: Which units may be advertised before the owner agrees the rent.
research_questions: How often did the review change the description before sending?

already_counted.description: Marketing vacant space to prospective tenants is already in the manager's step.

incremental.description: Correct advertising text the manager has not yet accepted.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: each advert is still written by hand, so sending is a small part. High: the text is accepted and sent, and the other methods remain. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show each stored rent beside the stored market band
Review rents to ensure they are in line with rental markets

tasks.design: The manager reviews rents to ensure they are in line with rental markets. {ERP} shows a stored rent beside a stored market band. A blank band stays blank and is not a new rent. The review stays at full effort. The manager sets the rent.
tasks.previous_blocker: The manager looked up rents and market notes and decided.
tasks.enabler_now: Two stored numbers can be shown side by side.
tasks.still_hard: Judging whether the rent is in line stays with the manager.
tasks.human_edge: The manager does not treat a blank band as a reason to change the rent.
tasks.altitude: The review stays the manager's decision. The screen only shows two stored numbers.

reach.learn: Which units the owner will not reprice.

evidence.claim: A stored rent and a stored market band can be shown together. Setting the rent stays manual.

assumptions: The work starts with a unit whose rent is due for review and ends when the manager has decided, or stops.
A rent row has unit identifier and rent, entered by the manager. A market row has area and band, entered by the manager from a recorded letting. A blank band is left blank.
The comparison does not change the rent. No notice to a tenant is sent in this task.
unknowns: Which market area the organisation uses for each property.
research_questions: How often was the market band blank, so the manager decided from other evidence?

already_counted.description: Reviewing rents against rental markets is already in the manager's step.

incremental.description: Correct a market band the manager has checked against a recorded letting.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: bands are often blank, so the review is unchanged. High: the two numbers show, and the manager still reviews the rent. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The manager still inspects sites, meets people, and decides rents, eligibility, and staff matters. A payment, contract, purchase, advertisement, or record is sent or written only after the manager accepts that version.
reach: An owner receives only a budget or a payment list the manager has accepted.
A contractor receives only a bid request or a contract the manager has accepted.
skills_to_grow: Stop when an amount, a date, or a required document is blank.
Accept or refuse the exact version before a send or a write.
Keep site inspections, tenant conversations, and eligibility decisions in their own hands.
role.ambitious_version: Every property has a budget and a record the owner can trust, and the manager still decides the exception.

job.title: Property, Real Estate, and Community Association Managers
